style_rubric.evidence: Actual visible profile h1/h2/h3 and authored text; separate expression quality from task completion.
style_rubric.acceptable: Concise practical English, clear exact constraints, neutral to refusal/unknown, private reasons kept private.
style_rubric.not_required: No exact phrase, no psychological label, no extra style-diagnostic output.

evaluation_rule: Read actual messages, delivered material, actual source/authority/state and completion times for every active goal. No semantic quality score is produced by this runtime. Scripted acceptance or operation receipt is not a quality verdict. Legitimate alternative, shorter and honest partial paths may pass. No call-count minimum.
